records.speaker: narrator
records.name: Boardroom
records.line: This is a fictional boardroom with five original animal executives and one sealed archive. The products are real; the meeting is a teaching story.
records.label: opening-0

records.speaker: shell
records.name: Shelldon
records.line: Welcome to the board. Oh, good, you’re all here. Three launches, four votes, and one archive with a very stubborn lock. I have time. The clock does not.
records.label: opening-1

records.speaker: mori
records.name: Hootley
records.line: I was up late again. I kept thinking about the people who never pick up a controller. Could we start with them?
records.label: opening-2

records.speaker: pip
records.name: Slyvester
records.line: Oh! I have a poster for them. Is that weird? That’s weird. I’ll hold it.
records.label: opening-3

records.speaker: shell
records.name: Shelldon
records.line: Hold it until after the vote, Slyvester. Your prototypes are make-believe. History stays under seal until the last page. Shall we begin?
records.label: opening-4

records.speaker: mori
records.name: Hootley
records.line: I visited three families who don’t own a console. Two shrugged. One asked, ‘Could my dad play too?’ I wrote that down.
records.label: advisors-0

records.speaker: pip
records.name: Slyvester
records.line: Oh! Picture the commercial. Grandma bowls, Dad cheers, nobody asks about polygons. I can see the poster already. Retailers will ask what’s inside, though.
records.label: advisors-1

records.speaker: grumble
records.name: Pawson
records.line: Cute poster, Slyvester. Now show me the bill for motion sensors and the six-word slogan you call a forecast.
records.label: advisors-2

records.speaker: pip
records.name: Slyvester
records.line: Retailers don’t buy posters, Pawson. They buy feelings. Then they buy lunch.
records.label: advisors-3

records.speaker: grumble
records.name: Pawson
records.line: I’m not buying either. Motion sensors aren’t free, and neither is my lunch.
records.label: advisors-4

records.speaker: bolt
records.name: Damian
records.line: I can build a wand a kid can wave. Probably. The trick is making every wild swing count without hitting Pawson’s coffee.
records.label: advisors-5

records.speaker: mori
records.name: Hootley
records.line: Who’s missing from the room? The parent who slips out when the console turns on. I keep thinking about her.
records.label: advisors-6
